existingFixParts.note: The OEM start-stop AGM battery for the 2019-2022 gas Lincoln Nautilus is the H7 / BCI Group 94R AGM (Motorcraft BAGM-94RH7-800, 800 CCA). This is the correct era/group for the 2nd-gen Edge/MKX-platform Nautilus and is the primary part for the documented fix (replace the weak/aged AGM battery). NOTE:
existingFixParts.component: 12V AGM start-stop battery (Group H7 / BCI 94R, ~800 CCA) — primary repair part

This is a software relearn, NOT a purchasable part, so no PN. Critical gotc
